# Docs

- [Scopture Docs](/docs): Understand what Scopture is and where to begin.
- Get Started
  - [What Is Scopture?](/docs/get-started/what-is-scopture): Understand the project context Scopture preserves and its role in physical-engineering work.
  - [Run a Design Review](/docs/get-started/design-review): A practical workflow for assembling evidence, capturing feedback, and carrying decisions into the next revision.
  - [Tutorials](/docs/get-started/tutorials): Guided introductions to the Scopture workspace, drawing tools, and review workflows.

- ** Definition **
- Concepts
  - [Canvas and Artifacts](/docs/concepts/canvas-and-artifacts): How Scopture brings project evidence into one spatial review surface.
  - [Model Parameters](/docs/concepts/model-parameters): Use editable Python parameters and modular Model Elements to build dynamic, reusable Scopture workflows.
  - [Charter, Issues, and Decisions](/docs/concepts/charter-issues-and-decisions): How Scopture turns project intent and review activity into an accessible decision trail.
  - [Versions and Revisions](/docs/concepts/versions-and-revisions): How to inspect, preserve, and recover meaningful project states in Scopture.
  - [Drawings, Sharing, and Export](/docs/concepts/drawings-sharing-and-export): How Scopture stores, shares, collaborates on, and exports drawings.

- ** Automation **
- [AI Providers](/docs/automation/ai-providers): Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Grok, and Perplexity to your Scopture drawings.
- [MCP Tool](/docs/automation/mcp-tool): How external agents inspect, reason over, and update Scopture project state under the same access and version controls as the application.
- [Command-Line Interface](/docs/automation/cli-tool): Use the CLI included with Scopture desktop to open, inspect, and automate local or remote drawings.
- [SQLite Runner](/docs/automation/sqlite-runner): Query drawing databases, join drawings, and apply scoped SQL changes through MCP or the CLI.
- [Python Sandbox](/docs/automation/python-sandbox): Run reusable models, engineering calculations and drawing automation with Scopture's shared Python runtime.
